findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document via `self.repo.get(doc_id)` without the `_owned` ownership check and ignores `user_id`, so any authenticated user can rename another user's document.
Because `rename` skips the ownership check, a nonexistent id raises `NotFound` while another user's id succeeds, leaking which document ids exist.
The ownership check should run before title validation so a non-owner gets `NotFound` rather than a title `ValueError`.
